Features

  • Githyanki War Magic

    After casing a spell or cantrip, can make a bonus weapon attack.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Psionic Empowerment

    Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

  • War Caster: Concentration

    You gain  Advantage on  Saving throws to maintain  Concentration on a Spell.

  • War Caster: Opportunity Spell

    You can also use a Reaction to cast  Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.

Gish For'reth is on the Mountain Pass during Act One.

Involvement

Act One

A gish specializing in psionics, For'reth is the primary spellcaster in  Kith'rak Voss' group searching for a powerful weapon.
